test_cases.description: initApp must pass the exact router instance returned by createAppRouter to mountApp, not a hardcoded value or a different object

mock_dependencies.routing_and_layout.createAppRouter: returns a unique sentinel router object

assertions: mountApp is called with the specific router object returned by createAppRouter

test_cases.description: When createAppRouter returns different router instances across separate invocations, mountApp must receive the corresponding instance each time — not a cached or hardcoded value

mock_dependencies.routing_and_layout.createAppRouter: returns different unique objects on successive calls

test_cases.description: initApp must call createAppRouter exactly once per invocation — not zero times, not twice — regardless of the specific router returned
assertions: createAppRouter call count is exactly 1 after initApp completes

test_cases.description: initApp must call mountApp exactly once per invocation — implementations that call it zero times or multiple times violate the contract
assertions: mountApp call count is exactly 1 after initApp completes

test_cases.description: When createAppRouter throws, mountApp must never be invoked — the error should propagate before mounting is attempted
Root must have no direct runtime dependency on shared_ui — it is consumed transitively through page_content and routing_and_layout
assertions: The root module source does not import from shared_ui

test_cases.description: Root must have no direct runtime dependency on pipeline_diagram — it is consumed transitively through child modules
assertions: The root module source does not import from pipeline_diagram

test_cases.description: Root must never manipulate slug strings directly — all slug handling is delegated to ensureLeadingSlash from routing_and_layout
assertions: initApp source code does not contain slug string manipulation patterns

test_cases.description: initApp must return void/undefined — it should not return the router or any other value
assertions: The return value of initApp() is undefined

test_cases.description: initApp must be exported as a callable function, not as a constant or object
Root must not re-export any child module types or constants — consumers import directly from the owning child module
assertions: Module exports contain no StepId, StepLabel, RouteSlug, StepContent, RouteEntry, or other domain types

test_cases.description: mountApp must be called with exactly one argument (the router instance) — not zero arguments or extraneous parameters
assertions: mountApp was called with exactly 1 argument

test_cases.description: createAppRouter must be called with zero arguments — root should not pass configuration or page components to it, as routing_and_layout handles that internally
Each invocation of initApp must call both createAppRouter and mountApp — a second call should not skip either due to caching or memoization
assertions: After two calls to initApp, createAppRouter called 2 times
After two calls to initApp, mountApp called 2 times

test_cases.description: initApp should execute synchronously — it should not return a Promise, ensuring the mount happens immediately
assertions: initApp() does not return a thenable/Promise
